neighbours.label: the token ' mon' opening a 'single/one' scientific or social term (monogamy, monosomy, monolayer)
fire: Many penguins favor monogamy over several years.
Geneticists screen for monosomy in early embryos.
The embryo carried a monosomy on one chromosome.
The wolves show strict monogamy within each pack.
The cells formed a flat monolayer in the flask.
Cultured neurons spread as a monolayer over glass.
The couple chose monogamy after many long talks.
Clinics detect monosomy with a simple blood test.
quiet: Many penguins favor cold water over several years.
Geneticists screen for trisomy in early embryos.
The embryo carried a trisomy on one chromosome.
The wolves show strict order within each pack.
The cells formed a flat sheet in the flask.
Cultured neurons spread as a film over glass.
The couple chose polygamy after many long talks.
Clinics detect anemia with a simple blood test.

notes: Probed monogamy and monosomies strongly, monolayer and monorail weakly. Top examples also include ' an', ' The', ' by', which this label does not explain, so coverage may be partial.
